Color identity: WUB | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 13 | Commander: legal
Produces: Near-infinite creature ETB; Near-infinite creature LTB; Near-infinite death triggers; Near-infinite lifeloss for all players; Near-infinite creature sacrifice triggers
Start: Sefris of the Hidden Ways (battlefield); Radiant Solar (battlefield); Undercover Operative (battlefield: as a copy of Radiant Solar); Clever Impersonator (battlefield: as a copy of Radiant Solar)
Prerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
  You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
Steps: Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
  When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Clever Impersonator and Undercover Operative each trigger.
  Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
  Resolve the Clever Impersonator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
  Resolve the Undercover Operative trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
  If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
  Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

## Combo 624-670-1619-5399
Cards: Sefris of the Hidden Ways + Radiant Solar + Phantasmal Image + Pirated Copy
Color identity: WUB | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 4 | Commander: legal
Produces: Near-infinite creature ETB; Near-infinite creature LTB; Near-infinite death triggers; Near-infinite lifeloss for all players; Near-infinite creature sacrifice triggers
Start: Sefris of the Hidden Ways (battlefield); Radiant Solar (battlefield); Phantasmal Image (battlefield: as a copy of Radiant Solar); Pirated Copy (battlefield: as a copy of Radiant Solar)
Prerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
  You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
Steps: Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
  When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Pirated Copy and Phantasmal Image each trigger.
  Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
  Resolve the Pirated Copy trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
  Resolve the Phantasmal Image trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
  If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
  Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

## Combo 670-1430-1619-3504

Start: Sefris of the Hidden Ways (battlefield); Radiant Solar (battlefield); Evil Twin (battlefield: as a copy of Radiant Solar); Pirated Copy (battlefield: as a copy of Radiant Solar)
Prerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
  You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
Steps: Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
  When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Evil Twin and Pirated Copy each trigger.
  Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
  Resolve the Evil Twin trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
  Resolve the Pirated Copy trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
  If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
  Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

Color identity: WUB | Bracket: Ruthless | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {4}{U}{U} each turn
Produces: Infinite turns; Lock
Start: Kykar, Zephyr Awakener (battlefield); Vampire Charmseeker (battlefield); Walk the Aeons (hand)
Steps: Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
  Kykar triggers, exiling Vampire Charmseeker.
  Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
  At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Vampire Charmseeker from exile to the battlefield.
  When Vampire Charmseeker enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
  Repeat each turn.

Start: Ephemerate (hand); Vampire Charmseeker (battlefield); Time Warp (hand)
Steps: Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
  Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Vampire Charmseeker and exiling Ephemerate.
  When Vampire Charmseeker enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
  Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
  Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Vampire Charmseeker.
  When Vampire Charmseeker enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
  Repeat.

## Combo 1011-2034-2728-4153
Cards: Genestealer Patriarch + Resourceful Defense + Fate Transfer + Ashnod's Altar
Color identity: WUB | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {1}{U/B}
Produces: Infinite colorless mana; Infinite death triggers; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers
Start: Genestealer Patriarch (battlefield); Resourceful Defense (battlefield); Fate Transfer (hand); Ashnod's Altar (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
  You control at least two additional creatures.
  An opponent controls a creature.
Steps: Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
  Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
  Cast Fate Transfer by paying {1}{U/B}, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto another creature you control.
  Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
  The creature dies, triggering Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability.
  Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
  Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
  Repeat from step 4.

  Repeat.
